rv.q: Governors State University Center for the Performing Arts Roars with Strife and Solemnity In Looking for Work whites and Blacks vie, stomping and shouting, for jobs just to feed their families.
Everything was choreographed and timed perfectly in this show.

cn.t: Critics praise this world premiere musical for its powerful examination of racial violence, with reviewers commending the professional production values and the established Chicago-area cast's compelling performances.
